reply:
The AI Travel Planner validates coordinates at render time rather than in the Zod schema because `streamObject` validates the entire object at once. If strict `lat`/`lng` bounds were enforced directly inside the Zod schema, a single bad coordinate from the model would cause the entire itinerary to be rejected instead of just failing gracefully. 

Filtering the coordinates during render in `ItineraryView` keeps any failures local, resulting in a single missing map pin rather than an entirely empty screen.

(Sources: resume, AI Travel Planner README)
